description: Header file defining the NuCachedSource2 class, which extends DataSource for cached media data handling in Android. Contains class declaration, methods, and internal enums.

classes.name: NuCachedSource2
classes.description: A class that manages cached media data source with buffering, fetching, and network handling capabilities.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of NuCachedSource2 with optional cache configuration and disconnect behavior.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks if the data source is properly initialized.

methods.name: readAt
methods.description: Reads data at a specified offset.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the data source.

methods.name: flags
methods.description: Returns flags associated with the data source.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the data source.

methods.name: getMIMEType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the data source.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.

methods.name: getAvailableSize
methods.description: Gets the available size from a specific offset.

methods.name: cachedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of cached data.

methods.name: approxDataRemaining
methods.description: Estimates remaining data to be fetched.

methods.name: setCacheStatCollectFreq
methods.description: Sets frequency for cache statistics collection.

methods.name: RemoveCacheSpecificHeaders
methods.description: Removes cache-specific headers from a header list.
